A '''bar''' was on the [[moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa]] and was owned and operated by a [[Unidentified Zabrak bartender's father|Zabrak]] [[bartender]] before he [[Death|died]] and passed it down to [[Unidentified Zabrak bartender|his son]].

==History==
Prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo]], the [[Sith apprentice]] [[Maul|Darth Maul]] came to the [[Cantina|bar]] and asked the bartender if he had information about the [[Auction of Eldra Kaitis|auction]] of a [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] held by the [[crime lord]] [[Xev Xrexus]] and it's [[Xev's hideout|location]]. When the customers accused Maul of being a Jedi, Maul angrily engaged them in a [[Altercation on Nar Shaddaa|bar fight]].<ref name="Darth Maul Part II>[[Darth Maul (2017) 2|''Darth Maul'' (2017) 2]]</ref>

[[File:NarShaddaaBar-2015StarWars8.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Luke Skywalker visits the bar to seek safe passage to Coruscant.]]
Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin]], [[Luke Skywalker]] made a visit to the bar seeking safe passage to [[Coruscant]]. The bartender ignored his request and told his customers to kill him. However, Skywalker managed to defend himself with [[Skywalker lightsaber|his]] [[lightsaber]]. The weapon piqued the [[Unidentified Zabrak bartender|Zabrak bartender's]] interest, and he decided to offer passage to Coruscant in exchange for the lightsaber. Skywalker declined his offer, prompting the bartender to once again order his customers to kill him and to also retrieve the lightsaber. Before they could, however, a [[Unidentified lightsaber thief (Nar Shaddaa)|thief]] inside the bar who worked for [[Grakkus Jahibakti Tingi|Grakkus]] the [[Hutt]] stole the lightsaber and escaped the establishment.<ref name="Star Wars 8" />

Responding to [[R2-D2]]'s distress call,<ref name="Star Wars 9">[[Star Wars (2015) 9|''Star Wars'' (2015) 9]]</ref> [[C-3PO]] and [[Chewbacca]] visited the bar, seeking information on Skywalker's whereabouts. The Zabrak bartender was uncooperative, telling the two that he did not welcome [[droid]]s and [[Wookiee]]s. C-3PO then challenged the bar patrons to a fight with Chewbacca. The Wookiee bested the bartender and his patrons, smashing at least one window in the process. The bartender then revealed that Skywalker had been captured by Grakkus the Hutt.<ref name="Star Wars 10">[[Star Wars (2015) 10|''Star Wars'' (2015) 10]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
At the beginning of [[Darth Maul (2017) 2|''Darth Maul'' (2017) 2]], the sign on the [[Cantina|bar]] says "JERLAESON". When [[Maul|Darth Maul]] engages the customers in a fight and the window is broken, the sign is different. It now says ''[panel begins]''FDLO" (note that the L, or [[Leth/Legends|Leth]], is mirror-inverted). In [[Star Wars (2015) 10|''Star Wars'' (2015) 10]], the sign ends in "JPL".
